note: The planner parameters the Rust server must be given (D-R85, D-R115): no published value, so not compiled in. Each value is the Python planner's, with the constant it comes from.

idle_power_w.source: stewie/specs/ipex_specs.py IDLE_POWER_W (mission_planner survival_energy_J = IDLE_POWER_W * duration; 0 = unmodelled)

slip_z_entrap_m.source: stewie/physics/slip.py slip_sinkage_equilibrium z_entrap default 2.0 * 0.18 (two wheel widths)

ipex_dig_j_per_kg.source: lode/planner_constants.py DIG_J_PER_KG = ipex_specs.dig_energy_per_kg() (the plan_math worksheet's constant)

ipex_drive_j_per_m.source: lode/planner_constants.py DRIVE_J_PER_M = ipex_specs.drive_energy_per_m() (the plan_math worksheet's constant)

slip_alpha.source: lode/planner_constants.py SLIP_ALPHA [CALIB] (slip energy multiplier vs tan(slope); the endurance reach field and the I10 costmap)

traffic_contact_width_m.source: stewie/twin/traffic_memory.py TrafficMemory.contact_width_m = the IPEx wheel contact width (rover_ipex.json contact_width_m) [ASSUMPTION]

fdc_baseline_a.source: stewie/physics/rassor_mass_model.py FDC_BASELINE_A: the empty-drum free-spinning current [CALIB] (NTRS 20210022781 Fig 8 structure)

fdc_slope_a_per_kg.source: stewie/physics/rassor_mass_model.py FDC_SLOPE_A_PER_KG: the current rise per kg carried at 1 g [CALIB]
